$comment: Phase 0.2 Medium-tier embedder task set — BEIR/SciDocs subset. Portability arm of the hybrid embedder-medium design (ADR-0016). Configures the harness to load a deterministic subset of the BEIR SciDocs corpus (~25k docs, ~1k queries at source), sample 5000 docs + 100 queries by SHA-256(id) rank, and score retrieval quality against BEIR's published qrels. Complements the domain arm at bench/tasks/embedder-medium-domain-openhands-ext.json. Post-hoc edit prohibited per §0.0a bullet 3 after first Medium-tier scored run.

subset.sampling_rationale: Deterministic subset selection: hash each doc_id and query_id with SHA-256, sort ascending, take first N. Same subset every run; portable across machines; no seed dependency.
subset.qrels_filtering: keep only qrels rows where BOTH query_id is in the sampled queries AND doc_id is in the sampled docs. All other qrels dropped.

queries.resolution: loaded from BEIR SciDocs test split, filtered by sampling method above

qrels.resolution: loaded from BEIR SciDocs test qrels, filtered per corpus.subset.qrels_filtering
qrels.relevance_note: BEIR SciDocs is graded 0/1 (binary) at the test-qrels level. Any doc appearing in qrels with score >= 1 is treated as relevant; all other docs are non-relevant.

metrics.aggregation_across_arms: reported per-arm; tier verdict uses macro-average across arms (see medium-scored.json)

runtime_expectations.note: 5000 docs at ~150 tokens avg + 100 queries at ~12 tokens avg. Any embedder cell exceeding hard_ceiling is R3-latency-outlier-flagged per fast-elimination.json (reused via medium-scored.json elimination phase).

post_hoc_edit_policy.note: Post-hoc edit prohibited after first Medium-tier scored run. Change requires either superseding ADR or a versioned re-authored task file.
